NAME:
   rancher inspect - Inspect a cluster, workload or project with its related objects

USAGE:
   rancher inspect [command] [flags]

COMMANDS:
   cluster, clusters:                Inspect a cluster: status, agent connectivity, machine pools, members, machines, and registration
   deployment, deployments, deploy:  Inspect a deployment and the pods it selects
   pod, pods, po:                    Inspect a pod: owners, metrics, and container logs
   project, projects:                Inspect a project: namespaces, members, resource quota, and usage
   user, users:                      Inspect a user: id and names, groups, and role bindings at global, cluster and project level

FLAGS:
   --help, -h  show help

GLOBAL FLAGS:
   --color string              auto|always|never
   --config string, -c string  path to the config directory [$RANCHER_CLI_CONFIG_DIR]
   --debug                     print telemetry upload details on stderr (development builds)
   --no-input                  never prompt; fail with an error when the input is ambiguous
   --output string, -o string  table|wide|json|yaml|name|template=<go-template>
   --read-only                 refuse commands that make changes in this run; once set it cannot be turned off; local commands do not accept it
